report:
Rectum, 1 cm from AV, suction rectal biopsy

Sections show a piece of large intestinal mucosa with submucosa. No ganglion cells are found. The biopsy also includes squamous and transitional mucosa of the anal canal. A total of 60 serial sections are examined. Immunostaining for calretinin shows positive nerve fibrils in the lamina propria and muscularis mucosae.

RECTUM, 1 cm from AV, suction rectal biopsy:
- INADEQUATE FOR EVALUATION (anal canal mucosa).

checks.message: No ganglion cells: the diagnosis line reads inadequate because the biopsy includes anal canal mucosa, and the zone just above the dentate line normally has few or no ganglion cells.

No ganglion cells are recorded, but calretinin shows positive mucosal nerve fibrils: the two disagree. The fibrils can extend 1-2 cm into aganglionic bowel (Kapur 2014), and a low biopsy may be physiologically hypoganglionic: review the level and the sections.
